questions.text: What does the server-authoritative timer protect against?
options: Students changing the clock on their phone
questions.hint: The timer lives on the server, not the browser.

questions.text: Switching to another app or leaving the exam tab is logged as a violation.
What is the name of the phase where skipped questions can still be answered using banked time?
questions.hint: It comes after the main one-question-at-a-time phase.

questions.text: How many tab-switch / focus-loss attempts cause the exam to be force-closed?
A normal website can completely block Messenger chat heads and system screenshots.
questions.hint: Browser JS cannot control OS-level overlays or the screenshot gesture.
